evaluate_boxes: run PASCAL VOC object detection evaluation on a dataset with all_boxes predictions and output results
write_voc_results_files: write PASCAL VOC detection results to result files for each class in the dataset
get_voc_results_file_template: get the file path template for VOC detection results for a given dataset and salt
do_python_eval: run the unofficial Python PASCAL VOC evaluation code and compute AP scores for each class
voc_info: retrieve PASCAL VOC dataset metadata including year, image set, devkit path, and annotation paths
